death.note: He was a relief to be rid of due to his audacity towards Muslim waqfs and lack of respect for them, along with his disdainful appearance and monopolization of his craft. He was succeeded by Talmās.

relation.note: He was succeeded by Talmās (وخلفه طلماس). Talmās appears only by this single name as the successor in the office of dallāl al-ʿaqārāt and is not independently attested in the corpus, so active is left empty with desc retained. Gemini had erroneously assigned TMP-P-000066 (= al-Kuwayk/D08850), an unrelated person.

person.note: 886番伝。 イスカンダル・ダッラール・アル＝アカーラートは878年シャアバーン月11日の金曜の夜に亡くなった。彼はその同業者の最後の人物であったが、ムスリムのワクフに対する大胆な行為や尊重しなかったこと、そしてその態度の軽蔑や彼の職業の独占性から、彼の死は安堵をもたらした。彼を継いだのはタルマースであった。

No. 886. Iskandar Dallāl al-ʿAqārāt died on Friday night, the 11th of Shaʿbān in the year 878. He was the last of his kind/group. However, his death brought relief due to his audacity regarding Muslim waqfs and his lack of respect for them, along with his disdainful appearance and monopolization of his craft. He was succeeded by Talmās.

respStmt.note: 原文「وخلفه طلماس」を照合。predecessor relationのactiveをGemini誤付与のTMP-P-000066（=الكويك/D08850、使い回し汚染）から除去。後継者طلماسは単名のみで原文中この1箇所のみ、独立立項なしのためactive=""・desc保持とした。
